MUFFLER.Settings.debug.Name: Enable debug logging
MUFFLER.Settings.debug.Hint: Log verbose Muffler diagnostics to the browser console.
MUFFLER.Settings.enabled.Name: Enable ducking
MUFFLER.Settings.enabled.Hint: Duck Foundry audio while others speak in the Discord voice channel.
MUFFLER.Settings.relayUrl.Name: Relay URL
MUFFLER.Settings.relayUrl.Hint: WebSocket URL of the Muffler bot relay (e.g. ws://localhost:8080).
MUFFLER.Settings.relayToken.Name: Relay token
MUFFLER.Settings.relayToken.Hint: Optional shared token; required only if the relay is configured with one.
MUFFLER.Settings.selfExclude.Name: Don't duck for my own voice
MUFFLER.Settings.selfExclude.Hint: When on, your own speaking does not duck your audio (resolves your Discord ID from the field below, then the GM mapping).
MUFFLER.Settings.ownDiscordId.Name: My Discord user ID
MUFFLER.Settings.ownDiscordId.Hint: Your Discord user ID, used for self-exclusion. Copy it from Discord with Developer Mode enabled.
MUFFLER.Settings.duckTarget.Name: Duck level
MUFFLER.Settings.duckTarget.Hint: Volume fraction (0-1) to duck music and ambient audio to while others speak.
MUFFLER.Settings.attackMs.Name: Attack (ms)
MUFFLER.Settings.attackMs.Hint: How quickly audio ducks when someone starts speaking.
MUFFLER.Settings.releaseMs.Name: Release (ms)
MUFFLER.Settings.releaseMs.Hint: How quickly audio restores after everyone stops speaking.
MUFFLER.Settings.holdMs.Name: Hold (ms)
MUFFLER.Settings.holdMs.Hint: How long to stay ducked after the last person stops, to avoid pumping during brief pauses.
MUFFLER.Settings.userMappingMenu.Name: Discord ID mapping
MUFFLER.Settings.userMappingMenu.Label: Edit user mapping
MUFFLER.Settings.userMappingMenu.Hint: Map Foundry users to Discord user IDs, used as the self-exclusion fallback.
MUFFLER.Mapping.Title: Muffler — User → Discord ID Mapping
